# Bank proof v2 fixture

`audit-manifest.json` has one row for each of the fixed ten banks and five requested FY2025 fields. A `verified` row must pass `checked_bank_locator` against the exact PDF bytes named by `source_manifest`; a `candidate` row is not an accepted fact, even when it retains a transcribed source value. The fixture stores filing metadata, PDF SHA-256, page, exact text excerpt/hash, unit conversion, and field status; PDF bytes stay under ignored research evidence.

Forty-eight records now pass `checked_bank_locator` with the applicable original sources. The follow-up adds all four Agricultural Bank ratios, Ningbo ROE and NIM, and Ping An ROE to the earlier 39 accepted records. Six new fields explicitly declare `scope_basis: cross_statement_bridge`; the checker binds the relevant calculations, consolidated statements, standalone comparisons, and excerpts to the actual PDF. Ningbo ROE instead uses its directly applicable Group calculation note on p236. See the [follow-up acceptance](../../../docs/review/bank-candidates-acceptance-2026-10-15.md).

The two Ningbo regulatory ratios now bind the annual report to a separately stored CCXI final rating report from ChinaMoney (item 3343869). Its p4 table explicitly states consolidated scope, uses the rightmost FY2025 column, and identifies the audited year-end data; note 3 preserves coverage's annual-report definition. The NPL balance also matches the annual p29 classification table. The earlier candidate decision and resolution plan remain in `previous_review`; the preliminary earnings flash remains corroboration only. This is a rating-agency-authored scope supplement, not a bank-authored statement or a new auditor opinion. Two Ping An regulatory ratios remain `scope_mismatch` with explicit standalone-scope evidence. `candidates-before-followup.json` freezes the original nine weak locators for negative regression tests; changing only status/scope claims must still fail.

CMB uses the existing run-02 official PDF and Adobe-GB1 CID decoding in memory; original bytes remain unchanged. Its consolidated balance-sheet equity line is on p128, bound to title/date/unit on p127. Jiangsu p113 equity distinguishes Group parent equity 337,961,238 thousand CNY from bank-only equity 326,222,007 and Group total equity 349,582,065. Ping An’s accepted equity remains explicitly derived from Group scope, wholly-owned subsidiary ownership, and the NCI presentation policy; its total-equity row alone is insufficient. Changshu’s Group ratios remain tied to p27, and Ping An NIM to p53. This follow-up does not change any of the preceding 39 accepted records or the two scope exclusions.

The Ningbo rule is limited to FY2025 NPL and provision coverage. It binds both PDF byte hashes, source identity, page/excerpt hashes, acquisition/check times, and owner-scoped stored refs on readback. The rating report's NIM uses a different definition and cannot replace the annual-report NIM. See [final Ningbo acceptance](../../../docs/review/ningbo-final-scope-acceptance-2026-10-16.md).
